direction: Still with a slow push in. This is the vestry interior: a small, plain, whitewashed room with new pine panelling and a narrow lancet window. A hanging surplice is on a peg. The assistant overseer (pale, clean-shaven, thin-rimmed spectacles, dark frock coat) sits at a deal table. In front of him are a large open rate book, an inkstand, a steel pen, blotting paper and a leather document case. A wooden bench runs along the wall where parishioners wait their turn. Nothing in the book is readable.

still.prompt: photoreal 16:9 still, interior of a small Victorian church vestry in 1872, whitewashed walls, new pine panelling, narrow lancet window with grey daylight, a surplice on a wooden peg, a pale clean-shaven official in his fifties with thin-rimmed spectacles and a dark frock coat seated at a plain deal table with a large open ledger, inkstand, steel dip pen, blotting paper and a leather document case, empty wooden bench along the wall, writing not legible, invented face, no text, no memorial tablets, no heraldry, no crests

captions.text: 1866: the present St Dochdwy's Church is consecrated; its c.1820 predecessor is moved and rebuilt at Leckwith
